name: Robotnik RB-FIQUS+
summary: Robotnik's outdoor omnidirectional mobile manipulator: a heavy, width-adjustable four-wheel platform (IP53, up to 9 h, slopes up to 20 %) with one or two Universal Robots arms (UR8 Long to UR30, up to 35 kg) on a front linear guide; the maker names construction among its uses.

germany.statusNote: Sold by the maker Robotnik Automation (Valencia, Spain) on request through its contact page; no public price, and Génération Robots does not list this model.

sellers.name: Robotnik Automation S.L.
sellers.note: "CONTACT US" on the product page; headquarters in Paterna (Valencia).

specs.label: Arm payload
specs.conditions: with UR30 (1300 mm reach); UR8 Long 10 kg, UR12e 12.5 kg, UR15 17.5 kg, UR20 25 kg

specs.label: Arm reach
specs.conditions: UR8 Long or UR20; plus ±300 mm on the linear guide

specs.label: Arm options
specs.value: UR8 Long, UR12e, UR15, UR20 or UR30 on a front linear guide (±300 mm); dual-arm configuration possible
specs.quote: mounted on a front linear guide, providing an additional transverse Y-axis diplacements ±300 mm. For enhanced operational versatility in the field, a dual-arm configuration allows two cobots to be installed on the same guide.

specs.label: Autonomy
specs.conditions: up to; 3 interchangeable 48 V 45 Ah batteries

specs.label: Slope
specs.quote: the ability to tackle slopes of up to 20%

specs.label: Platform width
specs.quote: the platform width is adjustable from 1,177 mm to 1,610 mm

specs.label: Base load capacity (RB-FIQUS platform)
specs.conditions: stated for the RB-FIQUS base without arm
specs.quote: With a load capacity of up to 1,000 kg at the base

specs.label: Included sensors
specs.value: RGBD camera, IMU, GPS, 2D safety LiDARs with safety PLC; 3D LiDAR and RTK base station optional

notes: One arm by default, a second cobot on the same guide as an option.
OnRobot and Robotiq grippers and stabilising legs are listed as options.
The 1,000 kg figure is given for the RB-FIQUS base; free payload with arms fitted is not stated.
